# Game Idea: Orb Escape

- Play in an HTML canvas, control a small triangle with arrow keys.
- Randomly spawning expanding orbs move across the canvas.
- Collect coins for points.
- **Lose condition:** touching any orb ends the game.
- Simple scoring and restart functionality.

<content>
1: // Game based on IDEA.md – Orb Escape
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Resize to fill parent or set a default size
9:   const resize = () => {
10:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
11:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
12:   };
13:   resize();
14:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
15: 
16:   // ----- Input handling & direction -----
17:   const keys = {};
18:   let playerDir = 0; // angle in radians
19:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
20:     keys[e.key] = true;
21:     // resume audio context on first interaction
22:     if (audioCtx && audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
23:     // update direction based on arrow keys
24:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') playerDir = -Math.PI / 2;
25:     else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') playerDir = Math.PI / 2;
26:     else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') playerDir = Math.PI;
27:     else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') playerDir = 0;
28:   });
29:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
30: 
31:   // ----- Entities -----
32:   const player = {
33:     x: canvas.width / 2,
34:     y: canvas.height / 2,
35:     size: 12, // length of triangle side
36:     speed: 3,
37:     draw() {
38:       // draw rotated triangle representing the player
39:       ctx.save();
40:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
41:       ctx.rotate(playerDir);
42:       // add glow effect
43:       ctx.shadowColor = '#0ff';
44:       ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
45:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
46:       ctx.beginPath();
47:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.size);
48:       ctx.lineTo(-this.size, this.size);
49:       ctx.lineTo(this.size, this.size);
50:       ctx.closePath();
51:       ctx.fill();
52:       ctx.restore();
53:     },
54:     update() {
55:       if (keys['ArrowUp']) this.y -= this.speed;
56:       if (keys['ArrowDown']) this.y += this.speed;
57:       if (keys['ArrowLeft']) this.x -= this.speed;
58:       if (keys['ArrowRight']) this.x += this.speed;
59:       // keep inside bounds
60:       this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width, this.x));
61:       this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height, this.y));
62:     },
63:   };
64: 
65:   const orbs = [];
66:   const coins = [];
67:   const particles = []; // explosion particles
68:   // audio setup
69:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
70:   const beep = (freq, duration) => {
71:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
72:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
73:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
74:     osc.type = 'sine';
75:     osc.connect(gain);
76:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
77:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
78:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
79:     osc.start();
80:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
81:   };
82: 
83:   let score = 0;
84:   let gameOver = false;
85: 
86:   // ----- Helper functions -----
87:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
88:   const distance = (x1, y1, x2, y2) => Math.hypot(x1 - x2, y1 - y2);
89: 
90:   const spawnOrb = () => {
91:     // spawn at random edge
92:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0 top,1 right,2 bottom,3 left
93:     let x, y, vx, vy;
94:     const speed = rand(0.5, 1.5);
95:     const radius = rand(10, 20);
96:     if (edge === 0) { // top
97:       x = rand(0, canvas.width);
98:       y = -radius;
99:       vx = rand(-1, 1) * speed;
100:       vy = speed;
101:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
102:       x = canvas.width + radius;
103:       y = rand(0, canvas.height);
104:       vx = -speed;
105:       vy = rand(-1, 1) * speed;
106:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
107:       x = rand(0, canvas.width);
108:       y = canvas.height + radius;
109:       vx = rand(-1, 1) * speed;
110:       vy = -speed;
111:     } else { // left
112:       x = -radius;
113:       y = rand(0, canvas.height);
114:       vx = speed;
115:       vy = rand(-1, 1) * speed;
116:     }
117:     orbs.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius, growth: rand(0.05, 0.15) });
118:   };
119: 
120:   const spawnCoin = () => {
121:     const radius = 8;
122:     const x = rand(radius, canvas.width - radius);
123:     const y = rand(radius, canvas.height - radius);
124:     coins.push({ x, y, radius, hue: rand(40, 60) }); // golden hue
125:   };
126: 
127:   // particle for explosion effect
128:   const spawnParticle = (x, y) => {
129:     const pCount = 12;
130:     for (let i = 0; i < pCount; i++) {
131:       const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       const speed = rand(1, 3);
133:       particles.push({
134:         x,
135:         y,
136:         vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
137:         vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
138:         radius: rand(2, 4),
139:         life: rand(30, 50),
140:         hue: rand(0, 360),
141:       });
142:     }
143:   };
144: 
145:   // initial spawns
146:   for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnOrb();
147:   for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnCoin();
148: 
149:   // ----- Game Loop -----
150:   const update = () => {
151:     if (gameOver) return;
152:     player.update();
153: 
154:     // update orbs
155:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
156:       const o = orbs[i];
157:       o.x += o.vx;
158:       o.y += o.vy;
159:       o.radius += o.growth;
160:       // remove if out of screen far enough
161:       if (o.x < -100 || o.x > canvas.width + 100 || o.y < -100 || o.y > canvas.height + 100) {
162:         orbs.splice(i, 1);
163:         spawnOrb();
164:       }
165:     }
166: 
167:     // update particles (explosions)
168:     for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
169:       const p = particles[i];
170:       p.x += p.vx;
171:       p.y += p.vy;
172:       p.life--;
173:       p.radius *= 0.96;
174:       if (p.life <= 0 || p.radius < 0.5) {
175:         particles.splice(i, 1);
176:       }
177:     }
178: 
179:     // coin collection
180:     for (let i = coins.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
181:       const c = coins[i];
182:       if (distance(player.x, player.y, c.x, c.y) < c.radius + player.size) {
183:         score++;
184:         // create small burst on collect
185:         spawnParticle(c.x, c.y);
186:         // play collect sound
187:         beep(300, 0.08);
188:         coins.splice(i, 1);
189:         spawnCoin();
190:       }
191:     }
192: 
193:     // collision with orbs -> game over with explosion
194:     for (const o of orbs) {
195:       if (distance(player.x, player.y, o.x, o.y) < o.radius + player.size) {
196:         gameOver = true;
197:         // spawn explosion particles at player location
198:         spawnParticle(player.x, player.y);
199:         // play game over sound
200:         beep(100, 0.3);
201:         break;
202:       }
203:     }
204:   };
205: 
206:   const draw = () => {
207:     // clear previous frame
208:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
209:     // background gradient
210:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
211:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
212:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#003');
213:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
214:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
215: 
216:     // draw orbs with radial gradient
217:     for (const o of orbs) {
218:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, o.radius * 0.3, o.x, o.y, o.radius);
219:       grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,80,80,0.9)');
220:       grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(150,0,0,0.4)');
221:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
222:       ctx.beginPath();
223:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
224:       ctx.fill();
225:     }
226:     // draw particles (explosion sparks)
227:     for (const p of particles) {
228:       ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${p.hue},100%,50%,${Math.max(p.life/50,0)})`;
229:       ctx.beginPath();
230:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
231:       ctx.fill();
232:     }
233:     // draw coins with subtle gradient
234:     for (const c of coins) {
235:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y, c.radius * 0.3, c.x, c.y, c.radius);
236:       grad.addColorStop(0, `hsl(${c.hue},80%,60%)`);
237:       grad.addColorStop(1, `hsl(${c.hue},80%,40%)`);
238:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
239:       ctx.beginPath();
240:       ctx.arc(c.x, c.y, c.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
241:       ctx.fill();
242:     }
243:     // draw player
244:     player.draw();
245:     // draw score
246:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
247:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
248:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
249:     // game over overlay
250:     if (gameOver) {
251:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
252:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
253:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
254:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
255:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
256:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 - 20);
257:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
258:       ctx.fillText('Press R to restart', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 30);
259:     }
260:   };
261: 
262:   const loop = () => {
263:     update();
264:     draw();
265:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
266:   };
267:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
268: 
269:   // restart handler
270:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
271:     if (gameOver && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r') {
272:       // reset state
273:       score = 0;
274:       gameOver = false;
275:       player.x = canvas.width / 2;
276:       player.y = canvas.height / 2;
277:       orbs.length = 0;
278:       coins.length = 0;
279:       for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) spawnOrb();
280:       for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnCoin();
281:     }
282:   });
283: })();

(End of file - total 283 lines)
